_purpose: Machine-readable source registry + data contracts. Every gauge names a source_id here; gauges.mjs refuses to emit a value for a source it cannot find. Answers, per dataset: who is authoritative, how often it publishes, how late it is by design, and when it stops being usable.

_authority_levels.PRIMARY_OFFICIAL: The issuing agency or the filer itself. Treat as authoritative.
_authority_levels.OFFICIAL_AGGREGATOR: Redistributes a primary source without editorial change (FRED over Fed/BEA/BLS/ICE).
_authority_levels.UNOFFICIAL_FREE: Undocumented public endpoint. Usable for development and for prices; NOT authoritative. Any conclusion resting on it must say so.
_authority_levels.EXPERT_HYPOTHESIS: A person's public commentary. A source of hypotheses to test, never a source of financial data.

_note_on_price_authority: A SIP/exchange-grade feed is the correct production source for quotes and this registry does not pretend otherwise. It is also several thousand USD a year, which is not proportionate to a single-user research tool. The honest position taken here: Yahoo stays as UNOFFICIAL_FREE, Stooq is registered as an independent cross-check, and any gauge built on prices carries authority_level UNOFFICIAL_FREE into the report rather than being silently promoted. Disagreement over whether that is acceptable is a scope question, not a data question — see docs/review-response.md §2.

fred.source_name: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis — FRED
fred.revision_policy: Series-dependent. FRED serves the LATEST vintage only — it silently overwrites revised history. Any backtest over this source has revision bias by construction; ALFRED vintages are required for that and are not yet wired.

yahoo.revision_policy: Splits and dividends restate history retroactively; no vintage access.
yahoo.caveat: Undocumented and unversioned. Can change shape or block without notice. Not authoritative for any published number.

stooq.role: independent cross-check on yahoo; disagreement beyond tolerance raises SOURCE_CONFLICT
stooq.status: registered, not yet wired (was serving a JS browser-check at last attempt)

sec_edgar.revision_policy: Amendments arrive as separate accessions; never overwrite a prior filing.
sec_edgar.point_in_time_key: accepted_at — the filing acceptance timestamp, NOT period_end
sec_edgar.status: registered, not yet wired — see docs/review-response.md §4

cboe.source_name: Cboe — SPX 0DTE share, SKEW, put/call ratios
cboe.auth: none for daily summary; OPRA-quality intraday is licensed
cboe.status: registered, not yet wired — 0DTE share is currently carried manually

finra.status: registered, not yet wired — carried manually

henren778.role: Supplies the hypotheses and the threshold values under test. Supplies NO financial data. Every number he states is re-derived from a registered data source before it is reported; where it cannot be, it is reported as his claim, attributed, and left unverified.

WRESBAL.description: Reserve balances held at Federal Reserve Banks

IORB.note: Short history. Percentile context on the SOFR-IORB spread is only meaningful post-2021.

BAMLH0A0HYM2.description: ICE BofA US High Yield Index option-adjusted spread

NFCI.description: Chicago Fed National Financial Conditions Index

M2SL.revision_policy: seasonal factors revised annually; recent months revised routinely
M2SL.note: LAGGED_BY_DESIGN. Comparing this to a same-day equity close is a temporal-join error — see the alignment rule in gauges.mjs.
M2SL._labeling_note: Monthly series labelled by month start; age measured from month end.

NCBEILQ027S.description: Nonfinancial corporate business; corporate equities; liability (Z.1)
NCBEILQ027S.revision_policy: revised for several quarters after first publication
NCBEILQ027S._labeling_note: FRED labels quarterly observations by period START. Measuring age from the label overstates staleness by ~90 days, so age is computed from period end.

GDP.revision_policy: advance / second / third estimates, then annual revisions
GDP._labeling_note: FRED labels quarterly observations by period START. Measuring age from the label overstates staleness by ~90 days, so age is computed from period end.

EQUITY_DAILY.description: Daily OHLC for indices, ETFs and single names
EQUITY_DAILY.authority_caveat: UNOFFICIAL_FREE — propagates to every gauge derived from it

VIXCLS.note: Replaces Yahoo ^VIX for the ignition gauge: FRED is OFFICIAL_AGGREGATOR and, unlike Yahoo, is still publishing the whole term-structure family.

VXVCLS.note: Yahoo's ^VIX3M / ^VIX9D / ^VIX6M all stopped returning closes after 2026-07-17, which is what made the old ignition gauge divide across a three-week gap.

SEC_CAPEX.revision_policy: amended filings supersede; latest filed value per span is used
SEC_CAPEX.note: 10-Q reports YTD cumulative, so discrete quarters are recovered by differencing. Layer A only — excludes finance leases (Layer B) and management guidance (Layer C).

manual_datasets._contract: No free live feed exists. Each carries the reading its source last published, that reading's effective date, and its own SLA. Past SLA the gauge emits STALE and is excluded from every headline count. It is never rendered as a current reading.

HYPERSCALER_CAPEX.blocker: Layer A (reported cash capex) is now wired from SEC XBRL. Layers B (finance leases) and C (management guidance) remain manual, so the signal is HYBRID, never AUTOMATED.
HYPERSCALER_CAPEX.status: Layer A automated 2026-08-10; B and C manual
